posts.cooked:
So far I've gotten 4 of the mini-expansions: Ambuscade, The Final Wasteland, Silver Gulch 1883 and Miss Information. The first 3 had these neat "title" cards witha biography on them, but Miss Information did not have one of these cards. I was wondering if her deck doesn't come with one of these cards, or if it was left out by mistake?

 

(Note: I'm not talking about her character card. I know the game is perfectly playable without it, but for collections sake I might still want it if there is one.)

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
I think that she has one.  I'll have to talk to a friend who just bought all of the Sentinels game (ALL of it, save for out-of-print promo cards).  As far as I know he should have one for her.  I definitely want all of them, too.  I have all of the cards in the game, but I only have the bio cards for Ambuscade and Unity.

EDIT:  And having those bios on the cards are quite handy for introducing players to these characters.  It's much, much easier telling someone "Here is Unity!  This bio card explains her quite well," rather than "Let me ramble on about this character I like.  Did I not do a good job?  Let me pull out The Internet and make you read it on my phone/laptop/tablet."
